detail: Full summary: Merge exposed four defects no lane suite could see: (1) rebuild() re-answered the bootstrap question after a policy existed and quarantined an entire migrated corpus (45→5 projections); (2) production: no adapter path cited the membership, so on any store that ran the ceremony EVERY mirrored 2.x write would have been quarantined and never projected; (3) the ceremony minted rulings its own store quarantined; (4) a literal NUL byte in src/retrieval/select.ts (caught by lane 02c's byte guard). All fixed with tests; 65 lane-04 fixture failures fixed in the fixtures via citeParents()/deliverUnderPolicy(), not by relaxing the rule.
